verdict: Correct conditional classical displacement energy interface, not an engineering certificate or actual peak-reduction theorem.

accepted_solution_domain.structure: Finite dimensional constant symmetric M,K positive definite after power-preserving constraints; constant symmetric C positive semidefinite; fixed finite port rows and transpose force assembly.
accepted_solution_domain.devices: Finite positive constant k,c,alpha; massless series Maxwell with monotone continuous signed inverse-power restoring term; no double counted spring storage.
accepted_solution_domain.regularity: Finite initial u,v,F; f locally L1; u prime equals v, v and branch forces locally AC, equations a.e.; stated weighted input norm finite on the interval.
accepted_solution_domain.L2_branch: C positive definite, or C positive semidefinite with f(t) in Range(C) a.e. and finite pseudoinverse budget.
accepted_solution_domain.L1_branch: Mass-weighted L1 input finite; C positive semidefinite and all device terms passive.
accepted_solution_domain.output: Fixed linear displacement row in same coordinates; for PSD K, output lies in Range(K).
accepted_solution_domain.external_power: All prescribed support, constraint and extra-port power included; current short identity assumes delta=B*u.
accepted_solution_domain.engineering: Actual physical M/K/C, ports, input projections, full initial storage and input norms require independent certification.

analytic_counterexamples.data: Scalar M=K=C=k=c=alpha=B=1, u=v=0, d=t, f=F, F=1-exp(-t).
analytic_counterexamples.reason: E=F^2/2 grows at order t^2; omitted-work one-quarter input budget is order t^3; actual missing power is F*dprime.
